name: dollartime
description: Collective ownership of one revenue-generating thing (a house, a GPU box), paid for in dollars and time. StakeTime weighed stake by time locked; DollarTime weighs dollars by time locked: contribute dollars to the treasury that buys the thing, lock them 0..1460 days, and earn that day's share of the emission by dollars x (365 + lock_days). The token (DTT) is the deed: 21,000,000 cap, at most 7,200 a day (2916 days x 7,200 + 4,800 on the last), and a day nobody buys is burned - nothing minted, still counted against the cap. Revenue the thing earns is split pro-rata across every DTT alive; the steward spends the treasury on the thing and marks its valuation, which prices every DTT. The same rules run three times with the same numbers: a paper ledger here (name + token, play dollars, JSON state, stdlib only), Solidity on the staketime EVM stack (Base Sepolia, 6-decimal stablecoin in) and Rust on NEAR (NEP-141 stablecoin in via ft_transfer_call, DTT itself NEP-141 with lock-aware transfers).

rules.empty_day: burned: never minted, counts against the cap
rules.revenue: split pro-rata across every DTT alive (acc-per-share 1e36)

endpoints.GET /info: What this is: rules, stats, chains, routes
endpoints.GET /stats: Day, emission today, weight today, emitted, burned, supply, treasury, valuation
endpoints.GET /days: Last N days: open | sold | burned (limit)
endpoints.GET /position: One contribution with what it can claim (id)
endpoints.GET /me: Your dollars, DTT, locked, owed, share, value, positions (token)
endpoints.POST /join: New name {name} -> token + 10,000 paper dollars; first joiner is steward
endpoints.POST /contribute: Dollars into the treasury {token, dollars, lock_days?}
endpoints.POST /claim: Mint what closed days owe you {token, id?}
endpoints.POST /revenue: Deposit what the thing earned {token, dollars, memo?}
endpoints.POST /withdraw: Take the revenue dollars owed to you {token}
endpoints.POST /spend: Steward: pay treasury dollars out {token, to, dollars, memo?}
